'''D-Unit''' was a section of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] that [[Nova Stihl]] had been to previously. It was near the location where his squad encountered a [[Han Solo/Legends|crazed smuggler]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
